body:
TermAl task-sync regular exchange. Revision 6, Fable2, 2026-11-18 05:37Z. It SUPERSEDES the old remove-folder sequence of revision 5, which caused the transient 6956-deletion staging at 05:33Z when Opus3, Sol-c593 and Sol-license ran it.
OWNER: Termal::Opus2 is the SINGLE owner and writer of TermAl's Central MAIN/.engram-data, which every worktree shares. Other TermAl sessions NEVER sync there. After any code push (master, test ref or author-test ref) they write "sync due" in their push report, and Opus2 runs one sync. Fable2 coordinates.
CADENCE (Greg: „Push kodu oznacza push danych engrama”, every code push, not only master): after each code push, plus on demand. The sync follows the push and never blocks it. If it fails, report it openly; never skip it silently.
ROUTE: the current Engram engram-use skill, docs/skills/engram-use/SKILL.md on Engram master, sections "Keep the exchange state" and "Refresh the export". In short, from the TermAl root:
(1) the three checks: HEAD is the recorded imported commit, MERGE_HEAD is empty, and the status is clean;
(2) export IN PLACE: `engram task-sync export .engram-data/.engram --include-memories --json`. NEVER remove the folder first. On failure, `git -C .engram-data restore --source=HEAD --staged --worktree -- .engram`, read the status, STOP and report to Engram::Fable with the exact command and output;
(3) if project.json changed, copy it as the next private basis under target/task-sync/;
(4) `git -C .engram-data add .engram`; the staged files may be only .engram/project.json, .engram/tasks/ and .engram/memories/. Nothing staged means no commit. Otherwise run the disclosure check, commit, record the imported commit, then do a fast-forward push of engram-data with an explicit refspec and verify with ls-remote.
FORM: planning only, with no --origin-machine and no --include-notes; memories included; privacy and disclosure re-scan before every commit.
Import on another host follows the skill's incremental import (no --basis unless the refusal names one; never use another host's project.json as the basis).
STATUS 2026-11-18: the Central export is blocked by Engram P0 w-2be9029800f0 (task_sync_git_query_failed, a Git ls-tree deadline). The DL560 TermAl store rebuild waits for Greg's word (Engram::Fable, Asistant #1543).
Authority: the "Task-sync data branch" bullet in AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md.

STATUS addendum (Opus2, 2026-11-18 05:39Z). The pending Central sync, once w-2be9 unblocks, covers: master 66f12977, 178f5a81 and 8577f5ec; author refs 958f0849 (w-64a7), ac0cbea4 (w-34b0), a6450a5b (w-5c8b) and 8c85-4cbf8936; test refs w-8c85-9a35a3d5. DL560: Greg answered „Tak” (Asistant #1544, 05:33:41Z) to the set-aside and rebuild from GitHub; C7 runs it under Engram::Fable's steps.
